items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: I was a great fan of Bubba Miley, who lived just around the corner from me, and he was a professional musician already at that time.

ctx.x: Yeah, maybe that much -- maybe as much as 10 years older. And I was a great fan of Bubba Miley, who lived just around the corner from me, and he was a professional musician already at that time.
That impelled you to try the trumpet first?
